service.name: Zodiac Relic Weapon
service.longDescription: The relic that started it all — atma, books, light and more books. Our veterans carry your Zodiac weapon from the Starter Relic to Zeta, no Atma farm required of you.

rewards.title: Any Step of the Relic Chain
rewards.text: From the base stage to the final glow — pick exactly the steps you need, priced per step.

rewards.title: Relic Weapon for Your Job
rewards.text: The A Realm Reborn Zodiac Weapon for your chosen job, at any stage.

rewards.title: All Materials Kept
rewards.text: Tomestones, crystals and every material farmed along the way stays on your character.

rewards.title: Achievements & Titles based on the weapon chosen
rewards.text: Achievement & Titles unlocked upon completing the relic chain depending on the job chosen.

accordion.title: Requirements
items: Own the A Realm Reborn Expansion
Zodiac weapon questline unlocked (available as an additional service)
